findings.issue: `energyFormIntegral_principal_add_lowerOrder`, `energyFormIntegral_principal_drift_mass`, and `energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_mass_add_perturbation` duplicate special-case proofs after the general `energyFormIntegral_add` / `energyFormIntegral_eq_one_zero_baseMass_add_perturbation` lemmas.

summary: Several decomposition lemmas restate special cases with fresh pointwise/integral proofs instead of deriving them from the general additive decomposition already introduced. This should be tightened so the API has one general proof path and special names are thin corollaries.
